**Ridges behind the home screen**

The home screen now shows, by default, ranges of mountains seen from afar in the colours of your theme instead of a picture: six jagged crests in the accent colour, one behind the other, over dark land, with a glow behind them as of a sun gone down, all made of the same square dots as before. They drift slowly, the nearer faster, fade out where the settings are written, and stop when the window is behind another one. In high contrast only the crests are drawn. Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ **Animate the background** keeps them still, as Reduce motion does.
